newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: VILLAGE TO BUY LAGUNA QUAYS FOR A$23 MLN.
newsitem.headline: VILLAGE TO BUY LAGUNA QUAYS FOR A$23 MLN.

text.p: Village Roadshow Ltd said on Thursday that it and the privately-held Staged Developments Australia Pty Ltd would acquire the Laguna Quays resort on Queensland's Whitsunday coast for A$23 million.
The company said Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, which placed the resort in receivership in May 1995, would provide a loan for the acquisition.
Village said it had an option to sell its 50 percent stake in three years to C+BUS Superannuation Fund, the largest industry superannuation fund in Australia.
The resort was developed by the Japanese-backed Aqua Del Ray, which spent more than A$230 million.
